title: JevSpawn: Adaptive Agentic Inference through Compositional Action Spaces
title_zh: JevSpawn：通过组合动作空间实现自适应智能体推理

paragraphs.en: LLM agents generate intermediate reasoning and actions token by token, making extended interactions slow and computationally expensive. Jev-style models offer fast probabilistic predictions over finite fields, but require those fields to be specified in advance. This requirement limits autonomous task solving, where the available actions must be derived from natural language instructions and adapted through interaction. We introduce JevSpawn, a compositional policy that connects natural language task specifications to finite probabilistic exploration. Parallel action spawning is coupled with feedback driven branch selection, representation revision, and recovery from retained alternatives. Shared action structure and model prefixes reduce repeated generation and context computation without additional training. Evaluations on eight benchmark tasks against seven agent baselines and a TypeSafe Jev variant establish JevSpawn as a promising approach to structured agentic inference, with improved task performance and faster navigation. Code is available at https://github.com/Hoyant-Su/JevSpawn .
paragraphs.zh: LLM 智能体以逐词方式生成中间推理和动作，导致扩展性交互过程缓慢且计算成本高昂。 Jev 风格模型能够在有限域上提供快速的概率预测，但要求这些域必须提前指定。 这一限制阻碍了自主任务解决能力，因为在自主任务中，可用动作必须从自然语言指令中推导出来，并通过交互进行调整。 我们提出了 JevSpawn，这是一种组合式策略，能够将自然语言任务规范与有限的概率探索连接起来。 并行动作生成与反馈驱动的分支选择、表示修订以及对保留替代方案的恢复相结合。 共享的动作结构和模型前缀减少了重复生成和上下文计算，而无需额外训练。 在八个基准任务上，通过与七种智能体基线模型及一种 TypeSafe Jev 变体的对比评估，证明了 JevSpawn 是一种有前景的结构化智能体推理方法，能够提升任务性能并加快导航速度。 代码可在 https://github.com/Hoyant-Su/JevSpawn 获取。

paragraphs.en: LLM agents solve tasks through tool use and repeated interaction with an environment ( Yao et al., 2023b ; Shinn et al., 2023 ; Guo et al., 2024 ) . Reasoning and actions are generated token by token, while observations enlarge the context for later steps. Exploring alternative actions adds further cost, limiting both the breadth and duration of interaction under a fixed inference budget.

paragraphs.en: Existing methods use this budget more effectively by organizing model calls and reducing intermediate information ( Yang et al., 2026 ; Yan et al., 2025 ) . Search favors promising trajectories, while workflow optimization removes redundant calls and parallelizes independent tools ( Zhou et al., 2024 ; Kim et al., 2024 ; Zhang et al., 2025b ; Hu et al., 2025b ; Wang et al., 2025a ) . Communication pruning, memory management, and latent exchange reduce the information passed between steps ( Zhang et al., 2025a ; Wang et al., 2025b ; Hu et al., 2025a ; Sun et al., 2026 ; Zou et al., 2026 ) . Further savings are possible within the actions themselves, since alternatives often share a form and differ in only a few arguments.
paragraphs.zh: 现有方法通过组织模型调用并减少中间信息，更有效地利用了这一预算（Yang et al., 2026；Yan et al., 2025）。 搜索策略倾向于有前景的路径，而工作流优化则能消除冗余调用并将独立工具并行化（Zhou et al., 2024；Kim et al., 2024；Zhang et al., 2025b；Hu et al., 2025b；Wang et al., 2025a）。 通信剪枝、内存管理和潜在变量交换能够减少步骤间传递的信息量（Zhang et al., 2025a；Wang et al., 2025b；Hu et al., 2025a；Sun et al., 2026；Zou et al., 2026）。 在动作本身内部还可以进一步节省资源，因为替代方案通常具有相同的形式，且仅在少数参数上存在差异。

paragraphs.en: To exploit this shared structure, repeated action descriptions can be replaced by predictions over finite fields. Constrained decoding enforces output rules and can skip deterministic continuations ( Beurer-Kellner et al., 2023 ; Geng et al., 2023 ; Dong et al., 2025 ; Zheng et al., 2024 ) . TypeSafe Jev returns typed values and probabilities for supplied questions without generating response strings ( Almeida, 2026 ) . The application must, however, define the fields in advance. For autonomous agents, suitable action fields must be inferred from instructions and revised as new observations arrive. The central challenge is to retain the speed of finite prediction while allowing the action space to change during interaction.
paragraphs.zh: 为了利用这种共享结构，重复的动作描述可以被有限域上的预测所替代。 受约束解码会强制执行输出规则，并且可以跳过确定性延续（Beurer-Kellner 等，2023；Geng 等，2023；Dong 等，2025；Zheng 等，2024）。 TypeSafe Jev 能为输入的问题返回带类型的值和概率，而无需生成响应字符串（Almeida，2026）。 然而，应用程序必须提前定义这些字段。 对于自主智能体，必须从指令中推断出合适的动作字段，并在新的观察结果到来时进行修订。 核心挑战在于，既要保持有限预测的速度，又要允许动作空间在交互过程中发生变化。

paragraphs.en: JevSpawn addresses this challenge by making the action fields part of the policy. Field values are combined into executable actions, and joint probabilities guide parallel spawning. Execution feedback guides branch selection and field revision, while retained branches support recovery from unsuccessful choices. Shared action structure and model context reduce repeated generation and computation. The resulting policy extends Jev-style prediction to sustained task solving without additional training.
paragraphs.zh: JevSpawn 通过将动作字段纳入策略来解决这一挑战。 字段值被整合为可执行的动作，联合概率则指导并行生成。 执行反馈引导分支选择和字段修订，而保留的分支则支持从失败选择中恢复。 共享的动作结构和模型上下文减少了重复的生成和计算。 由此产生的策略将 Jev 风格的预测方法扩展到了持续的任务解决中，且无需额外训练。

paragraphs.en: Our contributions are threefold. First, a compositional action representation connects natural language goals and interaction rules to executable finite fields, extending Jev-style prediction to tasks including spatial navigation. Second, a unified Jev-style architecture couples parallel spawning with feedback driven state transitions, representation revision, and recovery through retained branches. Third, parallel causal evaluation and shared prefix reuse provide a common computational basis for the finite policy, reducing repeated action generation and context processing.
paragraphs.zh: 我们的贡献有三方面。 首先，一种组合式动作表示将自然语言目标和交互规则连接至可执行的有限域，从而将 Jev 风格的预测方法扩展到包括空间导航在内的任务中。 其次，一种统一的 Jev 风格架构将并行生成与反馈驱动的状态转换、表示修订以及通过保留分支实现的恢复机制耦合在一起。 第三，并行因果评估和共享前缀重用为有限策略提供了共同的计算基础，减少了重复的动作生成和上下文处理。

paragraphs.en: Efficient agentic inference depends on both the computation requested by an agent and the cost of executing those requests ( Guo et al., 2024 ; Yang et al., 2026 ; Yan et al., 2025 ) . At the agent level, existing methods organize exploration or reduce intermediate information. Search and workflow optimization determine where model calls are spent ( Yao et al., 2023a ; Zhang et al., 2025b ; Hu et al., 2025b ) . LATS uses environment feedback to guide search ( Zhou et al., 2024 ) , LLMCompiler parallelizes tool calls ( Kim et al., 2024 ) , and DyFlow adapts workflows during execution ( Wang et al., 2025a ) . Fewer or better scheduled calls reduce wasted computation, but each interaction still carries messages and history needed for later actions.
paragraphs.zh: 高效的智能体推理既取决于智能体请求的计算量，也取决于执行这些请求的成本（Guo 等，2024；Yang 等，2026；Yan 等，2025）。 在智能体层面，现有方法会组织探索过程或减少中间信息。 搜索和流程优化决定了模型调用被分配到哪里（Yao 等，2023a；Zhang 等，2025b；Hu 等，2025b）。 LATS 利用环境反馈来指导搜索（Zhou 等，2024），LLMCompiler 对工具调用进行并行处理（Kim 等，2024），而 DyFlow 则在执行过程中调整工作流程（Wang 等，2025a）。 更少的或调度更优的调用可以减少计算浪费，但每次交互仍然会产生后续操作所需的消息和历史记录。

paragraphs.en: Reducing this information burden is the focus of communication and memory management ( Wu et al., 2023 ; Gao et al., 2024 ; Park et al., 2023 ; Packer et al., 2023 ; Shinn et al., 2023 ; Wang et al., 2024b ) . AgentPrune removes communication edges ( Zhang et al., 2025a ) , while AgentDropout removes unnecessary agents ( Wang et al., 2025b ) . HiAgent organizes subgoal memory ( Hu et al., 2025a ) , and Context Folding summarizes history ( Sun et al., 2026 ) . LatentMAS further reduces reliance on text by exchanging latent representations ( Zou et al., 2026 ) . Together, call scheduling and information reduction determine how much work reaches the model. The cost of that remaining work depends on how context is processed and outputs are generated.
paragraphs.zh: 减轻这种信息负担是通信和记忆管理的重点（Wu 等人，2023；Gao 等人，2024；Park 等人，2023；Packer 等人，2023；Shinn 等人，2023；Wang 等人，2024b）。 AgentPrune 会移除通信边（Zhang 等人，2025a），而 AgentDropout 则会移除不必要的智能体（Wang 等人，2025b）。 HiAgent 会对子目标记忆进行组织（Hu 等人，2025a），而 Context Folding 则会总结历史上下文（Sun 等人，2026）。 LatentMAS 通过交换潜在表示进一步减少对文本的依赖（Zou 等人，2026）。 总体而言，调用调度和信息削减共同决定了有多少任务会到达模型。 剩余任务的开销取决于上下文如何被处理以及输出如何被生成。

paragraphs.en: At this computational level, inference methods accelerate individual model requests. Transformer inference ( Vaswani et al., 2017 ) benefits from efficient attention ( Dao et al., 2022 ; Dao, 2023 ; Shah et al., 2024 ; Ye et al., 2025 ) , compact key and value representations ( Shazeer, 2019 ; Ainslie et al., 2023 ) , and improved scheduling and memory management ( Zhong et al., 2024 ; Patel et al., 2023 ; Agrawal et al., 2023 ; Agrawal et al., 2024 ; Prabhu et al., 2024 ) . Partitioning, offloading, and activation sparsity address additional resource constraints ( Aminabadi et al., 2022 ; Sheng et al., 2023 ; Song et al., 2023 ) . For repeated agent interactions, these per-request improvements can be extended by reusing the context shared across successive calls.
paragraphs.zh: 在这一计算层面上，推理方法能够加速单个模型请求。 Transformer 推理（Vaswani 等，2017）受益于高效的注意力机制（Dao 等，2022；Dao，2023；Shah 等，2024；Ye 等，2025）、紧凑的键值表示（Shazeer，2019；Ainslie 等，2023），以及优化的调度和内存管理（Zhong 等，2024；Patel 等，2023；Agrawal 等，2023；Agrawal 等，2024；Prabhu 等，2024）。 分区、卸载和激活稀疏性可应对额外的资源限制（Aminabadi 等，2022；Sheng 等，2023；Song 等，2023）。 对于重复的智能体交互，这些针对单个请求的改进可以通过复用连续调用之间共享的上下文来进一步扩展。

sents.en: At this computational level, inference methods accelerate individual model requests.
sents.zh: 在这一计算层面上，推理方法能够加速单个模型请求。

sents.en: Transformer inference ( Vaswani et al., 2017 ) benefits from efficient attention ( Dao et al., 2022 ; Dao, 2023 ; Shah et al., 2024 ; Ye et al., 2025 ) , compact key and value representations ( Shazeer, 2019 ; Ainslie et al., 2023 ) , and improved scheduling and memory management ( Zhong et al., 2024 ; Patel et al., 2023 ; Agrawal et al., 2023 ; Agrawal et al., 2024 ; Prabhu et al., 2024 ) .
sents.zh: Transformer 推理（Vaswani 等，2017）受益于高效的注意力机制（Dao 等，2022；Dao，2023；Shah 等，2024；Ye 等，2025）、紧凑的键值表示（Shazeer，2019；Ainslie 等，2023），以及优化的调度和内存管理（Zhong 等，2024；Patel 等，2023；Agrawal 等，2023；Agrawal 等，2024；Prabhu 等，2024）。

sents.en: Partitioning, offloading, and activation sparsity address additional resource constraints ( Aminabadi et al., 2022 ; Sheng et al., 2023 ; Song et al., 2023 ) .
sents.zh: 分区、卸载和激活稀疏性可应对额外的资源限制（Aminabadi 等，2022；Sheng 等，2023；Song 等，2023）。

sents.en: For repeated agent interactions, these per-request improvements can be extended by reusing the context shared across successive calls.
sents.zh: 对于重复的智能体交互，这些针对单个请求的改进可以通过复用连续调用之间共享的上下文来进一步扩展。

paragraphs.en: Prefix and text caching provide such reuse ( Yao et al., 2024 ; Gim et al., 2023 ; Juravsky et al., 2024 ; Ye et al., 2024 ) , with prefix aware scheduling extending reuse across workers ( Srivatsa et al., 2024 ) . Cache compression and selective retention or retrieval reduce the cost of accumulated history ( Xiao et al., 2023 ; Zhang et al., 2023 ; Liu et al., 2023c ; Li et al., 2024a ; Cai et al., 2024b ; Tang et al., 2024 ; Liu et al., 2024b ; Liu et al., 2024a ; Liu et al., 2023b ; Wang et al., 2024a ; Ge et al., 2023 ; Ribar et al., 2023 ) , while alternative context models use recurrence, compression, sparse attention, or linear attention ( Dai et al., 2019 ; Rae et al., 2019 ; Beltagy et al., 2020 ; Zaheer et al., 2020 ; Kitaev et al., 2020 ; Choromanski et al., 2020 ; Wang et al., 2020 ; Katharopoulos et al., 2020 ) . These methods reduce the cost of shared inputs, but exploring alternative actions can still require repeated output generation. JevSpawn targets this remaining cost by reusing compositional action fields across branches and selecting field values through finite probabilities.
paragraphs.zh: 前缀和文本缓存提供了这种重用机制（Yao 等，2024；Gim 等，2023；Juravsky 等，2024；Ye 等，2024），而感知前缀的调度则使这种重用能够跨智能体扩展（Srivatsa 等，2024）。 缓存压缩以及对缓存内容的选择性保留或检索可以降低累积历史信息的成本（Xiao 等，2023；Zhang 等，2023；Liu 等，2023c；Li 等，2024a；Cai 等，2024b；Tang 等，2024；Liu 等，2024b；Liu 等，2024a；Liu 等，2023b；Wang 等，2024a；Ge 等，2023；Ribar 等，2023），而替代的上下文模型则通过递归、压缩、稀疏注意力或线性注意力来实现（Dai 等，2019；Rae 等，2019；Beltagy 等，2020；Zaheer 等，2020；Kitaev 等，2020；Choromanski 等，2020；Wang 等，2020；Katharopoulos 等，2020）。 这些方法降低了共享输入的成本，但探索替代行动可能仍然需要重复生成输出。 JevSpawn 通过在不同分支间重用组合式行动字段，并通过有限概率选择字段值，来针对这一剩余成本进行优化。

paragraphs.en: Replacing repeated action generation requires a representation that preserves executable outputs. Constrained decoding provides a basis for such representations through fixed or input dependent grammars ( Beurer-Kellner et al., 2023 ; Geng et al., 2023 ) . Syntactic and semantic constraints improve program validity ( Scholak et al., 2021 ; Poesia et al., 2022 ) , although valid structure alone does not ensure accurate predictions ( Geng et al., 2025 ; Tam et al., 2024 ) . Formatting, option order, and context position can still affect the selected output ( Sclar et al., 2023 ; Liu et al., 2023a ; Zhao et al., 2021 ; Lu et al., 2021 ; Zheng et al., 2023 ) . A useful structured policy must therefore preserve both output validity and meaningful choices within the permitted space.
paragraphs.zh: 要替代重复的动作生成，需要一种能够保留可执行输出的表示方法。 受约束解码通过固定或依赖输入的语法规则，为这类表示方法提供了基础（Beurer-Kellner 等，2023；Geng 等，2023）。 句法和语义约束能够提升程序的合法性（Scholak 等，2021；Poesia 等，2022），但仅凭合法的结构本身并不能确保预测的准确性（Geng 等，2025；Tam 等，2024）。 格式、选项顺序和上下文位置仍然可能影响最终选定的输出（Sclar 等，2023；Liu 等，2023a；Zhao 等，2021；Lu 等，2021；Zheng 等，2023）。 因此，一个有效的结构化策略必须同时保留输出的合法性以及允许空间内的有意义选择。

paragraphs.en: Meeting these requirements during decoding raises two further issues, the cost of enforcing constraints and the effect of constraints on output probabilities. XGrammar largely hides this overhead through cached token checks and overlap with GPU execution ( Dong et al., 2025 ) , while SGLang skips deterministic grammar paths and reuses context ( Zheng et al., 2024 ) . Constraint overhead is reduced, while distributional fidelity requires separate treatment. DOMINO preserves valid continuations across tokenization boundaries ( Beurer-Kellner et al., 2024 ) , and grammar aligned decoding corrects distributional distortion from local token masking ( Park et al., 2024 ) . Even with efficient enforcement and improved fidelity, choices not fixed by the grammar are still generated sequentially.
paragraphs.zh: 在解码过程中满足这些要求会引发两个进一步的问题：强制执行约束的成本以及约束对输出概率的影响。 XGrammar 主要通过缓存的令牌检查和与 GPU 执行的重叠来隐藏这种额外开销（Dong 等人，2025），而 SGLang 则跳过确定性语法路径并重复利用上下文（Zheng 等人，2024）。 约束带来的额外开销得以降低，但分布保真度则需要单独处理。 DOMINO 能够在分词边界之间保留有效的续写内容（Beurer-Kellner 等人，2024），而语法对齐解码则能纠正局部令牌掩码所导致的分布失真（Park 等人，2024）。 即使实现了高效的强制执行并提升了保真度，未被语法固定的选择仍然需要按顺序生成。

paragraphs.en: This remaining sequential cost motivates methods that produce or verify several tokens at once. Speculative decoding accelerates generation through parallel verification ( Leviathan et al., 2022 ; Chen et al., 2023 ; Li et al., 2025 ; Fu et al., 2024 ; Miao et al., 2024 ) , using drafts from auxiliary models, prediction heads, retrieval, or earlier layers ( Cai et al., 2024a ; Li et al., 2024c ; Li et al., 2024b ; He et al., 2023 ; Zhang et al., 2024 ; Elhoushi et al., 2024 ; Bhendawade et al., 2024 ; Cheng et al., 2024 ) . Nonautoregressive and insertion based models change the output factorization ( Gu et al., 2017 ; Ghazvininejad et al., 2019 ; Gu et al., 2019 ; Stern et al., 2019 ; Wang et al., 2018 ) , while diffusion models refine sequences iteratively ( Li et al., 2022 ; Lou et al., 2023 ; Sahoo et al., 2024 ; Nie et al., 2025 ) . These methods accelerate the production of output sequences. When the possible values are already known, the task can instead be expressed as finite prediction over those alternatives.
paragraphs.zh: 这种剩余的序列成本促使了能够一次性生成或验证多个标记的方法。 推测性解码通过并行验证加速了生成过程（Leviathan 等，2022；Chen 等，2023；Li 等，2025；Fu 等，2024；Miao 等，2024），利用辅助模型、预测头、检索或早期层的草案（Cai 等，2024a；Li 等，2024c；Li 等，2024b；He 等，2023；Zhang 等，2024；Elhoushi 等，2024；Bhendawade 等，2024；Cheng 等，2024）。 非自回归和基于插入的模型改变了输出的因子分解方式（Gu 等，2017；Ghazvininejad 等，2019；Gu 等，2019；Stern 等，2019；Wang 等，2018），而扩散模型则通过迭代方式优化序列（Li 等，2022；Lou 等，2023；Sahoo 等，2024；Nie 等，2025）。 这些方法能够加速输出序列的生成。 当可能的取值已知时，该任务可以转化为在这些备选值上进行有限预测。

paragraphs.en: TypeSafe Jev provides this finite interface by evaluating supplied questions in parallel and returning typed values with probabilities ( Almeida, 2026 ) . Response strings need not be generated, but the application must define the fields being predicted. JevSpawn addresses this dependence on predefined fields by making the action space part of the policy. Compositional fields are inferred from task context and revised through feedback, coupling finite prediction with parallel spawning and recovery across interaction rounds.

paragraphs.en: JevSpawn and the seven agent baselines use Qwen3.8-27B as the pretrained policy and run on four H100 GPUs with tensor parallelism and bfloat16 precision. The batch size is 8, the context limit is 16,384 tokens, and each generation is limited to 2,048 tokens. Tasks receive up to 36 exploration rounds and a final submission step, within a 300 second limit. Temperature is zero, thinking mode is disabled, and the seed is 42. JevSpawn selects one parent and spawns up to four distinct actions per expansion. A further variant replaces finite scoring with TypeSafe Jev and retains Qwen for declarations and text generation. End-to-end (E2E) latency measures elapsed time from task submission to termination. Appendix B provides timing definitions and execution details.

paragraphs.en: Eight tasks from five benchmarks are used to compare JevSpawn with LATS ( Zhou et al., 2024 ) , LLMCompiler ( Kim et al., 2024 ) , AgentPrune ( Zhang et al., 2025a ) , HiAgent ( Hu et al., 2025a ) , FoldAgent ( Sun et al., 2026 ) , DyFlow ( Wang et al., 2025a ) , and LatentMAS ( Zou et al., 2026 ) . PPNL evaluates path planning from natural language specifications ( Aghzal et al., 2023 ) . Maze from LMRL Gym and Grid from LLF Bench evaluate navigation with action feedback ( Abdulhai et al., 2025 ; Cheng et al., 2023 ) . LightsOut, RushHour, and Sokoban from TextArena assess sequential puzzle solving ( Guertler et al., 2025 ) , while 2048 and Nullify from KORGym assess numerical game play ( Shi et al., 2025 ) . Evaluation uses the public PPNL test collections, fixed Maze initial states, and environment seeds 42 through 141 for the remaining tasks.
paragraphs.zh: 来自五个基准测试的八项任务被用于将 JevSpawn 与 LATS (Zhou et al., 2024)、LLMCompiler (Kim et al., 2024)、AgentPrune (Zhang et al., 2025a)、HiAgent (Hu et al., 2025a)、FoldAgent (Sun et al., 2026)、DyFlow (Wang et al., 2025a) 和 LatentMAS (Zou et al., 2026) 进行比较。 PPNL 评估基于自然语言规范的路径规划 (Aghzal et al., 2023)。 LMRL Gym 中的 Maze 和 LLF Bench 中的 Grid 用于评估结合动作反馈的导航能力 (Abdulhai et al., 2025; Cheng et al., 2023)。 TextArena 中的 LightsOut、RushHour 和 Sokoban 用于评估顺序谜题解决能力 (Guertler et al., 2025)，而 KORGym 中的 2048 和 Nullify 则用于评估数值游戏表现 (Shi et al., 2025)。 评估过程使用了公开的 PPNL 测试集、固定的 Maze 初始状态，以及其余任务的环境种子值 42 到 141。

paragraphs.en: Against the seven agent baselines, JevSpawn achieves the highest scores on five of eight tasks in Table 1 . Success rates of 0.96 and 0.95 are achieved on Maze and Grid, compared with 0.52 and 0.73 for FoldAgent. LightsOut reward reaches 0.61 against AgentPrune’s 0.34. Nullify reward reaches 0.21 against 0.09 for HiAgent and FoldAgent, and the 2048 score reaches 305.12 against LLMCompiler’s 5.00. AgentPrune remains strongest on PPNL, RushHour, and Sokoban.
paragraphs.zh: 在与七种智能体基线模型的对比中，JevSpawn 在表 1 的八项任务中有五项取得了最高分数。 在迷宫和网格任务上，其成功率分别达到 0.96 和 0.95，而 FoldAgent 的成功率仅为 0.52 和 0.73。 LightsOut 任务的奖励值达到 0.61，高于 AgentPrune 的 0.34。 Nullify 任务的奖励值达到 0.21，高于 HiAgent 和 FoldAgent 的 0.09；而 2048 任务的分数达到 305.12，高于 LLMCompiler 的 5.00。 AgentPrune 在 PPNL、RushHour 和 Sokoban 任务中依然表现最强。

paragraphs.en: JevSpawn achieves joint quality and latency gains on Maze and Grid. Alongside the success rate improvements, E2E latency is reduced from the fastest baseline values of 47.91 and 61.44 seconds to 40.91 and 40.58 seconds. Figure 3 places JevSpawn on the Pareto frontier in nearly all bootstrap resamples for seven tasks. Sokoban frontier membership is less stable, reflecting a 1.50 second latency margin over LLMCompiler and a lower score.
paragraphs.zh: JevSpawn 在 Maze 和 Grid 任务上同时提升了质量和延迟表现。 除了成功率的提升，端到端延迟也从最快的基线值 47.91 秒和 61.44 秒降低到了 40.91 秒和 40.58 秒。 图 3 显示，在七个任务中，JevSpawn 几乎在所有自助重采样中都位于帕累托前沿上。 Sokoban 任务的前沿归属性则不太稳定，反映出其延迟比 LLMCompiler 高出 1.50 秒，且得分较低。

paragraphs.en: JevSpawn extends Jev-style prediction to agentic inference by making the finite action space adaptive. A compositional policy couples parallel spawning with feedback driven exploration, representation revision, and branch recovery. Shared structure and prefix computation reduce the cost of evaluating alternatives without additional training. Experiments demonstrate higher scores across several tasks and reduced latency in navigation.
paragraphs.zh: JevSpawn 通过将有限的动作空间变为自适应的，将 Jev 风格的预测方法扩展到了智能体推理领域。 一种组合式策略将并行生成与反馈驱动的探索、表示修订和分支恢复相结合。 共享结构和前缀计算降低了评估替代方案的成本，而无需额外训练。 实验表明，该方法在多个任务中获得了更高的分数，并减少了导航延迟。

paragraphs.en: Task context contains the goal, initial observation, interaction rules, and answer format, shared across methods. Method prompts are supplied separately, with core JevSpawn excerpts in Appendix B.6 . Benchmark interfaces execute and score actions, and copied environment states support branch exploration. paragraphs.en: Time to first token (TTFT) spans batch preparation and prefill through the first generated token. Inter-token latency (ITL) measures successive token intervals within a sequence, including interleaved finite evaluations. Finite evaluation latency covers preparation, context processing, and value scoring for a complete batch. Queueing and environment execution are timed separately.
paragraphs.zh: 首个词元时间（TTFT）涵盖了批处理准备和从预填充到生成首个词元的过程。 词元间延迟（ITL）衡量序列中连续词元之间的间隔，包括交错进行的有限次评估。 有限次评估延迟涵盖了完整批次的准备、上下文处理和值评分过程。 排队和环境执行的时间将分开计时。

paragraphs.en: Text decoding throughput divides tokens emitted after the first token by the corresponding batch decoding duration measured with CUDA events. Intervals with interleaved finite evaluation are excluded. Isolated decoding uses the same token and time definitions on replayed requests. Text generation throughput in the batch scaling experiment includes prefill and decoding. Finite throughput counts requests per second, with one request evaluating an option set containing multiple assignments.
paragraphs.zh: 文本解码吞吐量是将首个令牌之后输出的令牌数除以通过 CUDA 事件测量的对应批量解码时长所得。 包含交错有限评估的区间被排除在外。 独立解码在重放请求时采用相同的令牌和时间定义。 批量扩展实验中的文本生成吞吐量包括预填充和解码。 有限吞吐量以每秒请求数计算，其中每个请求会评估一个包含多个分配的选项集。

sents.zh: 两个父智能体实现了最高的迷宫和网格成功率，而四个父智能体则实现了最高的 2048 分。

sents.en: The action budget is fixed across configurations.
sents.zh: 各配置中的动作预算是固定的。

paragraphs.en: Declaration revision is disabled after the first executable declaration in Table 6 . Feedback and branch selection remain active. Fixed declarations improve scores on four tasks and reduce latency on six, while adaptive declarations score higher on the other four tasks.
paragraphs.zh: 在表 6 中的第一个可执行声明之后，声明修订功能将被禁用。 反馈和分支选择仍然保持激活状态。 固定声明在四项任务上提升了得分，并在六项任务上降低了延迟，而自适应声明则在其余四项任务上获得了更高的得分。

sents.en: Declaration revision is disabled after the first executable declaration in Table 6 .
sents.zh: 在表 6 中的第一个可执行声明之后，声明修订功能将被禁用。

sents.en: Feedback and branch selection remain active.
sents.zh: 反馈和分支选择仍然保持激活状态。

sents.en: Fixed declarations improve scores on four tasks and reduce latency on six, while adaptive declarations score higher on the other four tasks.

paragraphs.en: Table 6 restricts observations to the current branch history. Shared observations reduce latency on all eight tasks and improve scores on PPNL, Sokoban, 2048, and Nullify. Restricting observations improves scores on Maze, Grid, LightsOut, and RushHour.
paragraphs.zh: 表 6 将观察范围限制在当前分支的历史记录中。 共享观察结果降低了全部八个任务的延迟，并提升了 PPNL、Sokoban、2048 和 Nullify 的得分。 限制观察结果提高了 Maze、Grid、LightsOut 和 RushHour 的得分。

sents.en: Table 6 restricts observations to the current branch history.
sents.zh: 表 6 将观察范围限制在当前分支的历史记录中。

sents.en: Shared observations reduce latency on all eight tasks and improve scores on PPNL, Sokoban, 2048, and Nullify.
sents.zh: 共享观察结果降低了全部八个任务的延迟，并提升了 PPNL、Sokoban、2048 和 Nullify 的得分。

sents.en: Restricting observations improves scores on Maze, Grid, LightsOut, and RushHour.
sents.zh: 限制观察结果提高了 Maze、Grid、LightsOut 和 RushHour 的得分。

paragraphs.en: Round limits of 36, 54, 72, and 108 are evaluated at a context limit of 131,072 tokens, with all other settings fixed. Each condition is run with a 300 second deadline and without a deadline. Table 7 reports scores, E2E latency, and timeout rates for the timed series. Figure 10 shows the score trends.
paragraphs.zh: 在上下文限制为 131,072 个词元且所有其他设置固定的情况下，对 36、54、72 和 108 的轮次限制进行了评估。 每个条件都以 300 秒的时限和无时限两种情况进行运行。 表 7 报告了计时系列中的得分、端到端延迟和超时率。 图 10 展示了得分的趋势。

sents.en: Round limits of 36, 54, 72, and 108 are evaluated at a context limit of 131,072 tokens, with all other settings fixed.
sents.zh: 在上下文限制为 131,072 个词元且所有其他设置固定的情况下，对 36、54、72 和 108 的轮次限制进行了评估。

sents.en: Each condition is run with a 300 second deadline and without a deadline.
sents.zh: 每个条件都以 300 秒的时限和无时限两种情况进行运行。

sents.en: Table 7 reports scores, E2E latency, and timeout rates for the timed series.
sents.zh: 表 7 报告了计时系列中的得分、端到端延迟和超时率。

sents.en: Figure 10 shows the score trends.
sents.zh: 图 10 展示了得分的趋势。

paragraphs.en: Without a deadline, the 2048 score rises from 315.16 at 36 rounds to 603.72, 912.52, and 1102.24 at 54, 72, and 108 rounds. LightsOut reward rises from 0.61 to 0.876. Navigation success changes little, and RushHour reward peaks at 0.47 at 72 rounds before declining to 0.44.
paragraphs.zh: 如果没有截止日期，2048 的分数会从第 36 轮时的 315.16 上升到第 54、72 和 108 轮时的 603.72、912.52 和 1102.24。 LightsOut 的奖励从 0.61 上升到 0.876。 Navigation 的成功率变化不大，而 RushHour 的奖励在第 72 轮时达到峰值 0.47，随后下降至 0.44。

sents.en: Without a deadline, the 2048 score rises from 315.16 at 36 rounds to 603.72, 912.52, and 1102.24 at 54, 72, and 108 rounds.
LightsOut reward rises from 0.61 to 0.876.
sents.zh: LightsOut 的奖励从 0.61 上升到 0.876。

sents.en: Navigation success changes little, and RushHour reward peaks at 0.47 at 72 rounds before declining to 0.44.
sents.zh: Navigation 的成功率变化不大，而 RushHour 的奖励在第 72 轮时达到峰值 0.47，随后下降至 0.44。

paragraphs.en: With the deadline enforced, 82 and 85 percent of 2048 tasks time out at 72 and 108 rounds, reducing scores to 96.60 and 124.84. Sokoban reaches a timeout rate of 77 percent at 108 rounds. Timed out tasks receive zero reward.
paragraphs.zh: 在强制截止期限下，2048个任务中分别有82%和85%的任务在第72轮和第108轮超时，得分降至96.60和124.84。 在108轮时，Sokoban的超时率达到77%。 超时的任务将获得零奖励。

sents.en: With the deadline enforced, 82 and 85 percent of 2048 tasks time out at 72 and 108 rounds, reducing scores to 96.60 and 124.84.
sents.zh: 在强制截止期限下，2048个任务中分别有82%和85%的任务在第72轮和第108轮超时，得分降至96.60和124.84。

sents.en: Sokoban reaches a timeout rate of 77 percent at 108 rounds.
sents.zh: 在108轮时，Sokoban的超时率达到77%。

sents.en: Timed out tasks receive zero reward.
sents.zh: 超时的任务将获得零奖励。

paragraphs.en: At 108 rounds without a deadline, mean E2E latency reaches 464.67 seconds on 2048 and 415.77 seconds on Sokoban, with 99th percentiles of 612 and 559 seconds. Sokoban reward increases from 0.12 at 36 rounds to 0.18. In 2048, 92 percent of tasks exceed 300 seconds and nine percent exceed 600 seconds. The longest observed run takes 623 seconds.
paragraphs.zh: 在没有截止期限的情况下，经过 108 轮后，平均端到端延迟在 2048 上达到 464.67 秒，在 Sokoban 上达到 415.77 秒，第 99 百分位分别为 612 秒和 559 秒。 Sokoban 的奖励从 36 轮时的 0.12 增加到 0.18。 在 2048 中，92% 的任务超过 300 秒，9% 的任务超过 600 秒。 观测到的最长运行时间为 623 秒。

sents.en: At 108 rounds without a deadline, mean E2E latency reaches 464.67 seconds on 2048 and 415.77 seconds on Sokoban, with 99th percentiles of 612 and 559 seconds.
sents.zh: 在没有截止期限的情况下，经过 108 轮后，平均端到端延迟在 2048 上达到 464.67 秒，在 Sokoban 上达到 415.77 秒，第 99 百分位分别为 612 秒和 559 秒。

sents.en: Sokoban reward increases from 0.12 at 36 rounds to 0.18.
sents.zh: Sokoban 的奖励从 36 轮时的 0.12 增加到 0.18。

sents.en: In 2048, 92 percent of tasks exceed 300 seconds and nine percent exceed 600 seconds.
sents.zh: 在 2048 中，92% 的任务超过 300 秒，9% 的任务超过 600 秒。

sents.en: The longest observed run takes 623 seconds.
sents.zh: 观测到的最长运行时间为 623 秒。

paragraphs.en: Removing only the deadline at the main context limit of 16,384 tokens and 36 rounds yields success rates of 0.951, 0.96, and 0.94 on PPNL, Maze, and Grid.
paragraphs.zh: 仅移除主上下文限制（16,384个词元和36轮）中的截止日期，PPNL、Maze和Grid的成功率分别为0.951、0.96和0.94。

paragraphs.en: Batch scaling replays 128 fixed requests for each of text generation and finite evaluation, with one warmup and three measured repetitions per batch. Throughput includes input processing. Finite evaluation is separated by history length and measured in requests per second, with each request scoring one option set.
paragraphs.zh: 批量扩展会针对文本生成和有限评估中的每个任务重放 128 个固定请求，每批包含一次预热和三次测量重复。 吞吐量包含输入处理。 有限评估按历史长度分开，并以每秒请求数进行测量，每个请求对一组选项进行评分。

sents.en: Batch scaling replays 128 fixed requests for each of text generation and finite evaluation, with one warmup and three measured repetitions per batch.
sents.zh: 批量扩展会针对文本生成和有限评估中的每个任务重放 128 个固定请求，每批包含一次预热和三次测量重复。

sents.en: Throughput includes input processing.
sents.zh: 吞吐量包含输入处理。

sents.en: Finite evaluation is separated by history length and measured in requests per second, with each request scoring one option set.
sents.zh: 有限评估按历史长度分开，并以每秒请求数进行测量，每个请求对一组选项进行评分。

paragraphs.en: Text generation throughput, including prefill, peaks at batch size 16, increasing from 138.2 to 164.2 tokens per second relative to batch size 8. Mean ITL rises from 12.28 to 17.54 milliseconds between batch sizes 8 and 64. Finite throughput remains near 28 requests per second for short histories and six for long histories at both batch sizes 8 and 16.
paragraphs.zh: 文本生成吞吐量（包括预填充）在批量大小为 16 时达到峰值，与批量大小为 8 的情况相比，每秒生成的词元数从 138.2 增至 164.2。 在批量大小从 8 增加到 64 的过程中，平均 ITL 从 12.28 毫秒上升至 17.54 毫秒。 无论批量大小是 8 还是 16，对于短历史，有限吞吐量均保持在每秒约 28 次请求；而对于长历史，则保持在每秒 6 次请求。

paragraphs.en: The largest completed batch sizes are 64 for text generation and 16 for finite evaluation. The next tested sizes, 128 and 32, exceed GPU memory.
paragraphs.zh: 已完成的最大批量大小为文本生成时的 64 和有限评估时的 16。 接下来测试的大小 128 和 32 超出了 GPU 内存容量。

paragraphs.en: One instance from each benchmark task illustrates how finite action fields support exploration. JevSpawn attains the maximum reward on seven selected instances, whereas most baselines do not complete the corresponding task. The 2048 example is compared by accumulated score. Consecutive rounds are shown in alternating colors, with observations condensed to the returned state changes and terminal feedback. Branch identifiers link states across rounds, and bold identifiers mark the submitted path. Recovery in a round title denotes a return to an earlier branch. Field identifiers label the slots in each action template.
paragraphs.zh: 每个基准任务中的一个实例展示了有限动作域如何支持探索。 JevSpawn 在七个选定的实例中获得了最大奖励，而大多数基线方法则未能完成相应的任务。 2048 示例通过累计分数进行比较。 连续回合以交替颜色显示，观察结果被浓缩为返回的状态变化和终止反馈。 分支标识符将不同回合中的状态连接起来，粗体标识符则标记了已提交的路径。 回合标题中的“恢复”表示回到了之前的某个分支。 域标识符用于标注每个动作模板中的槽位。

paragraphs.en: The goal lies beyond two obstacles in the top row. The selected path descends to the second row, crosses below both obstacles, and returns to the goal in seven moves.
paragraphs.zh: 目标位于顶行两个障碍物之后。 所选路径向下延伸至第二行，从两个障碍物的下方穿过，然后以七步返回目标。

paragraphs.zh: 仅能获取局部墙壁的观察信息。 初始的向右移动被阻挡了。 后续的选择会沿着已观察到的走廊前往目标，而无需完整的地图。

paragraphs.en: Room descriptions reveal adjacent doors and visible objects. The six submitted actions include one blocked move before the treasure is reached. paragraphs.en: Vehicle and direction fields express the available sliding actions. Exploration returns to retained alternatives before selecting a path of nine actions that releases the red car.
paragraphs.zh: 车辆和方向字段表示可用的滑动动作。 探索会回到保留的备选方案中，然后选择一条包含九个动作的路径来释放红色汽车。

paragraphs.en: A declaration over four movement commands supports both navigation and box pushing. Exploration revisits earlier branches before selecting a solution with four moves that places both boxes on their goals.
paragraphs.zh: 一项包含四个移动指令的声明同时支持导航和推箱操作。 探索过程会重新访问早期的分支，然后选择一个包含四步移动的解决方案，将两个箱子都放置到目标位置。

paragraphs.en: The selected trajectory contains 31 moves and is submitted at the round limit with a merge score of 1076. KORGym draws new tiles from powers of two up to half the largest tile, or inserts a two when the largest tile is below four. Newly inserted tiles do not contribute to the merge score.
paragraphs.zh: 所选轨迹包含 31 步，在回合限制时提交，合并得分为 1076。 KORGym 会从二的幂次中抽取新瓦片，最大不超过最大瓦片的一半；若最大瓦片小于四，则插入一个二。 新插入的瓦片不计入合并得分。

sents.zh: 所选轨迹包含 31 步，在回合限制时提交，合并得分为 1076。

paragraphs.en: Two index fields select units for arithmetic operations, with the goal of eliminating all units. A solution with seven actions is found after revisiting retained branches. The initial domain omits unit 8, valued at -7. Reindexing after the first action brings that unit into the declared range, and the third action eliminates the unit.
paragraphs.zh: 两个索引字段为算术运算选择单位，目标是消除所有单位。 在重新访问保留的分支后，找到了一个包含七个动作的解决方案。 初始域省略了值为 -7 的单位 8。 第一个动作后的重新索引将该单位纳入声明的范围，而第三个动作则消除了该单位。
